title: Event Contract Terms Lint
description: Lints a prediction-market event contract's declared settlement terms (source agency, fallbacks, revision rule, discretion, dispute window, outcome review, early close) against a caller-declared policy. One PASS or FINDING line per policy item plus one intrinsic consistency check; verdict PASS, PASS_WITH_FINDINGS or FAIL. Enums, flags, integers and opaque labels only; URLs and identifier-like values are refused. Never a legality or fairness opinion.

profile.description: Venue profile. kalshi_rulebook_v1_29 pins finding bases to the rulebook passages on the page; generic takes all rules from caller policy.

as_of.description: Effective date for the profile selection, YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

terms.description: The contract's DECLARED settlement terms: enums, booleans, integers and one opaque label only. No prose, no URLs, no identifiers.

contract_label.description: Opaque label, 1..64 chars over [A-Za-z0-9 _.-]. Anything that looks like a URL, address or hash is refused and never echoed.

carveout_clause.description: Whether the contract declares a carve-out clause (for example a death or violence carve-out).

unresolvable_fallback.description: What the contract declares happens when the outcome cannot be resolved.

revision_after_settlement.description: Whether the contract allows the declared terms to be revised after settlement.

source_agency_kind.description: The declared kind of the source agency that publishes the underlying or expiration value.

fallback_sources_count.description: How many fallback sources the contract declares.

revision_rule.description: Which release of the source data the contract declares as governing.

expiration_value_rule.description: The declared shape of the expiration-value computation.

discretion_clause.description: Whether the contract declares that the venue keeps discretion to interpret the terms.

outcome_review_available.description: Whether the contract declares an outcome review process.

dispute_window_hours.description: How long a dispute stays open, in hours, as declared.

settlement_delay_hours_max.description: The declared maximum settlement delay in hours.

outcomes_exhaustive.description: Whether the declared outcomes are exhaustive.

outcomes_exclusive.description: Whether the declared outcomes are mutually exclusive.

policy.description: The caller policy. Every item optional; only declared items produce finding lines. forbid/require mismatches drive FAIL; thresholds drive findings.

require_unresolvable_fallback.description: Policy requires a declared unresolvable-outcome fallback (not 'none').

require_outcome_review.description: Policy requires outcome review to be available.

require_exhaustive_exclusive.description: Policy requires outcomes to be exhaustive and exclusive.
